subject: P0 PEER-CHECK HANDOFF: cold-cache branch confirmed; stale-display synchronous takeScreenshot crash narrowed
body: Independent peer check CORROBORATES Lane B cold/warm divergence but materially narrows the proposed crash mechanism. Current PanelEngine cache-hit path directly presents cached INNER right-pane; cache miss enters startEffect/capture and can fall back from null/unavailable Shizuku capture to AccessibilityService.takeScreenshot. That call is locally unwrapped, and Beta2 transform preserves it. However AOSP explicitly reports a missing/invalid display as callback ERROR_TAKE_SCREENSHOT_INVALID_DISPLAY rather than synchronous exception; Duo Open handles onFailure and declares canTakeScreenshot=true. PanelEngine.destroy also increments captureGen so later callbacks become stale. Therefore cold-cache fallback remains a strong first-vs-later discriminator, but "display removed -> synchronous takeScreenshot exception -> crash" is not supported by AOSP as the leading causal chain. Keep instrumentation across the full cold fallback (cache result, Shizuku result, before/after framework call, callback/error, display lifecycle, generation, surface creation, death marker). Current beta2 crash trace is still absent, so no field causality claimed.
